Structure:
- <!DOCTYPE html>, head with meta charset, title "Neon Neural Growth", inline <style> and inline <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js"></script> (dat.gui is the ONLY external library).
- CSS: body background #05070f, centered flex layout, canvas 800x800 with box-shadow glow, radial background glow using #101a3a, UI/accent color #ffd400 for a small caption label. No images, no textures, no other assets.
- One <canvas id="c" width="800" height="800">.

JavaScript (vanilla, no modules, no other libs), organized with clear short section comments:
1. SETUP: canvas/ctx, W=H=800, palette constants (BG '#05070f', BG_GLOW '#101a3a', BRANCH '#00e5ff', ACCENT '#d6ff00', SYNAPSE '#ff2bd6', PULSE '#fff36a', UI '#ffd400', GRID 'rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)').
2. params object: neuronCount (3-6), growthSpeed, maxDepth, splitChance, curvature, maxBranchLength, synapseDist, synapseGlow, pulseSpeed, pulseFreq, pulseBrightness, bgColor, branchColor, accentColor, synapseColor, pulseColor, showGrid, vignette, paused.
3. GUI SETUP: dat.gui with folders 'Growth' (neuronCount, growthSpeed, maxDepth, splitChance, curvature, maxBranchLength), 'Synapses' (synapseDist, synapseGlow), 'Pulses' (pulseSpeed, pulseFreq, pulseBrightness), 'Visuals' (bgColor, branchColor, accentColor, synapseColor, pulseColor, showGrid, vignette) plus buttons 'regenerate network' (regenerateNetwork), 'clear canvas' (clearCanvas), 'pause/resume animation' (togglePause). Use onFinishChange for structural params (neuronCount, maxDepth, maxBranchLength) to regenerate.
4. DATA: arrays neurons[], branches[], synapses[], pulses[]. Branch object: {x,y,angle,len,width,depth,parent,points[],growT,alive,color}. Use lightweight plain objects.
5. NEURON GROWTH: generate 3-6 random seed neurons near center (within radius ~90 of center). Each seed spawns 2-4 initial branches with random angles. Recursive growth: each branch grows step-by-step (animated, not instant) — each frame advance growT by growthSpeed; while growing, extend the branch along a smoothly curving angle (angle += curvature * (noise-ish random walk), slight random jitter) and push points into points[] every few pixels so rendering uses quadratic curves through the points. Randomly vary width slightly (width = base * (0.6 + random*0.5)), decreasing with depth. With probability splitChance spawn a smaller side branch (depth+1, shorter max length, thinner). Limit by maxDepth and a global MAX_BRANCHES cap (~400) for performance. Growth stops when no branches are growing (stable size).
6. SYNAPSE DETECTION: for each pair of branch tips (endpoints) within synapseDist, create a synapse unless a duplicate synapse already exists between the same pair of branches (check existing synapses for same branch ids). Store synapse {a,b,phase}. Cap synapse count.
7. PULSE ANIMATION: after growth stabilizes, spawn pulses periodically based on pulseFreq along random existing synapses; pulse = {syn,i,t,speed} moving smoothly via interpolation (t += pulseSpeed*dt, wrap/remove at t>1). Randomly activate different paths over time. Pulses appear as moving electric sparks.
8. RENDERING: clear with bgColor; draw faint radial background glow (#101a3a) and optional grid/scanlines using rgba(0,229,255,0.08); draw branches as thin glowing neon lines using quadraticCurveTo through stored points with ctx.shadowBlur and ctx.shadowColor = branchColor (accent color for side branches); draw synapses as soft glowing dots pulsating over time (brighter than branches, shadowBlur scaled by synapseGlow); draw pulses as bright sparks at interpolated positions with shadowBlur; draw a faint vignette (radial gradient darkening edges); optional subtle animated background noise/scanlines drawn on canvas only.
9. MAIN LOOP: requestAnimationFrame loop with dt clamping; skip updates when paused but still render; update growth, synapse detection, pulses, then render.

Keep code compact and readable, plain ES5/ES6 (no modules). No mention of any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted style in code or comments. Ensure everything works offline except the dat.gui CDN script."}
